name: Prep-Ahead Lunches
instructions: Build lunches around a grain base, a protein, and a raw or quick-cooked vegetable so nothing goes soggy by day 3.
Keep any dressing or sauce in a small separate container and add it right before eating.
Pack proteins and grains warm-to-room-temperature, not hot, before sealing to avoid excess condensation in the container.
Reheat gently (30-60 sec increments) if using a microwave, stirring in between, so nothing overcooks around the edges.
